locations.name: Blue Mountain Racing Circuit
locations.description: A 4.8 km circuit that follows the lie of the land, with a start-finish straight of nearly 700 m, a full-throttle straight of over a kilometre and a flowing middle section. The pits and team compound sit in the infield. A concept layout for illustration, not BMR's published design.

locations.name: Pit Lane
locations.description: Cars peel off before the final corner, run past the garages for tyres and repairs, and rejoin the start-finish straight. Grandstands A, B and C look straight down onto it.

locations.name: Pit / Conference Building
locations.description: The heart of the venue. Teams work from the garages on race weekends, and the floors above host conferences, exhibitions and events all year. Visitors reach it over the pedestrian bridge to the south entrance.

locations.name: Paddock
locations.description: The teams' home for the weekend, right behind the garages: support units, equipment awnings and loading courts, kept separate from the public.

locations.name: Grandstand A
locations.description: Covered grandstand at the southern end of the start-finish straight, looking across to the pit building. Illustrative.

locations.name: Grandstand B
locations.description: Covered grandstand on the start-finish straight, opposite the pit garages and the start line. Illustrative.

locations.name: Grandstand C
locations.description: Covered grandstand at the northern end of the start-finish straight, beside Grandstand B, opposite the pit exit and the run to Turn 1. Illustrative.

locations.name: Grandstand D
locations.description: Covered grandstand outside the hairpin at the end of the long straight. Illustrative.

locations.name: Grandstand E
locations.description: Covered grandstand overlooking the heavy braking zone into Turn 1. Illustrative.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 1
locations.description: Grass bank on the infield side of the short run from Turn 1 to Turn 2, curving with the track.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 2
locations.description: Curved viewing bank wrapped around the outside of the eastern sweeper, directly behind its runoff.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 3
locations.description: Curved grass bank around the outside of the southern return, behind the runoff.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 4
locations.description: Grass bank tucked inside the left-hander after the southern return, east of the operations bridge.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 5
locations.description: Curved grass bank around the outside of the penultimate corner, behind its runoff.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 6
locations.description: Grass bank wrapped around the outside of the final corner, looking up the start-finish straight.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 7
locations.description: Long grass bank on the outside of the full-throttle straight, western half.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 8
locations.description: Long grass bank on the outside of the full-throttle straight, towards the hairpin braking zone.

locations.name: Arrival Plaza
locations.description: The public front door of the venue, between the gateway arch, the halls and the pit / conference building.

locations.name: Grandstand Fan Walk
locations.description: Tree-lined processional avenue from the gateway arch, through the arrival plaza, to a concourse behind Grandstands A, B and C. Banners line it all year, with food and merchandise stalls on race weekends.

locations.name: Gateway Arch
locations.description: The landmark arch at the western edge of the arrival plaza.

locations.name: Plaza Tower North
locations.description: Stone-clad tower marking the northern side of the arrival plaza.

locations.name: Plaza Tower South
locations.description: Stone-clad tower marking the southern side of the arrival plaza.

locations.name: Exhibition Hall 1
locations.description: Smaller exhibition hall beside the arrival plaza, for conventions and meetings. The largest shows use the lakeside Expo Centre.

locations.name: Exhibition Hall 2
locations.description: Smaller exhibition hall beside the arrival plaza, for conventions and meetings. The largest shows use the lakeside Expo Centre.

locations.name: Expo Centre
locations.description: The venue's largest exhibition space: four connected halls on a glazed central concourse, about 5 hectares, facing the lake. Trucks load from Waterfront Drive on its western side.

locations.name: Expo forecourt
locations.description: Lake-facing public arrival court for the Expo Centre, running out to the promenade on the west quay of the show basin.

locations.name: Expo loading yard
locations.description: Truck docks along the western side of the Expo Centre, served directly from Waterfront Drive and kept apart from visitors.

locations.name: Expo Walk
locations.description: Public walk from the arrival concourse and Car Park P8 to the Expo Centre forecourt, which opens onto the lakeside promenade.

locations.name: Amphitheatre
locations.description: Stepped open-air bowl for concerts and events, facing the arrival plaza.

locations.name: Amphitheatre Lawn
locations.description: Smooth grass bank rising behind the amphitheatre's top tier, for picnic seating at concerts.

locations.name: The Lake
locations.description: A man-made lake of about 19 hectares with a built quay all round. The western show basin faces the Expo Centre and holds the fountain show. A neck crossed by a footbridge joins it to the eastern boating basin and its marina cove.

locations.name: Lakeside Promenade
locations.description: A 14 m paved quay walk on the water's edge all the way round the lake, with a stone coping, lamps and a row of trees. It links the Expo forecourt, the piazza, the marina cove, the restaurants and the hotels.

locations.name: Lake Piazza
locations.description: Paved square on the north quay of the show basin, at the end of the Waterfront Walk. Its landing steps down to the water, facing the fountain show.

locations.name: Lake Terraces
locations.description: Stepped stone terraces and lawns either side of the piazza, rising away from the water under timber pergolas, with a low landing at the water's edge. Seating for the fountain show and fireworks.

locations.name: Piazza Kiosks
locations.description: Four small kiosks on the piazza for coffee, ice cream and paddle board hire. Illustrative.

locations.name: Waterfront Walk
locations.description: Tree-lined public walk from the ring road south to the Lake Piazza.

locations.name: Pavilion Point
locations.description: Park on the northern peninsula between the two basins, with the restaurant decks on either side and the footbridge at its tip.

locations.name: Lake Footbridge
locations.description: Pedestrian bridge over the neck of the lake, from Pavilion Point to the Waterfront Hotel. The best place to watch the fountain show to the west and the boats to the east.

locations.name: Lake Fountain Show
locations.description: A 200 m arc of jets across the show basin, between two end basins and a tall central jet, in view of the Expo forecourt, the piazza and the hotels. Hover over it or select it to run the show. Illustrative.

locations.name: Marina Cove and Paddle Boats
locations.description: Jetty and ticket kiosk in the square cove on the north shore, where paddle boats are hired for a turn around the boating basin. Illustrative.

locations.name: Lake Fireworks Display
locations.description: Launch barge moored on the lake for evening fireworks displays after race days, concerts and conferences. Illustrative.

locations.name: Lakeside Restaurant West
locations.description: Timber pavilion with a dark metal roof on a deck over the water, off the south quay of the show basin, facing the fountain show.

locations.name: Lakeside Restaurant Central
locations.description: Timber pavilion with a dark metal roof on a deck over the water, on the west side of Pavilion Point, facing the fountain show.

locations.name: Lakeside Restaurant East
locations.description: Timber pavilion with a dark metal roof on a deck over the water, on the east side of Pavilion Point, facing the boating basin.

locations.name: Waterfront Hotel
locations.description: Tower hotel on the southern peninsula, at the foot of the footbridge, with views over both basins to the circuit.

locations.name: Lakeside Lodge
locations.description: Low-rise hotel on the south quay of the boating basin, fronting the promenade.

locations.name: Promenade Hotel
locations.description: Mid-rise hotel on the south quay of the show basin, fronting the promenade and facing the fountain show.

locations.name: Karting Track
locations.description: The first step on the driving pathway: an outdoor karting circuit for lessons and club racing, in the academy campus.

locations.name: Karting Clubhouse
locations.description: Karting preparation, timing and a viewing deck in the south-west academy campus.

locations.name: Karting Garages
locations.description: Two rows of small lock-up garages beside the clubhouse, opening onto the karting pit apron, with rear access from the campus road.

locations.name: Karting pit apron
locations.description: Paved working apron between the karting garages and the track.

locations.name: Driving Academy
locations.description: Academy classrooms and simulators beside the karting track in the south-west campus.

locations.name: Academy Skid Pad
locations.description: Open square of low-grip surface where drivers learn to control skids and slides, with painted circles and cones. Part of the driving academy and advanced driving courses.

locations.name: Skid pad markings
locations.description: Painted boundary and two control circles on the skid pad.

locations.name: Skid pad control cabin
locations.description: Instructor cabin overlooking the skid pad.

locations.name: Automotive Hub
locations.description: Engineering workshops in a separate eastern automotive campus, connected to the test pad and demonstration compound.

locations.name: Automotive Test Pad
locations.description: Vehicle test apron beside the external Automotive Hub.

locations.name: Infield drainage and grass reserve
locations.description: Open grass and drainage behind the team compound, kept clear as a buffer between the paddock and the track.

locations.name: Trackside Residences East
locations.description: Apartments and townhouses either side of their own street, with a residents' club behind. Illustrative.

locations.name: Residences East Street
locations.description: Residential street off the ring road, between the apartments and the townhouses.

locations.name: Tennis Courts East
locations.description: Two floodlit tennis courts for residents of the east estate. Illustrative.

locations.name: Swimming Pool East
locations.description: 25 m residents' pool beside the tennis courts. Illustrative.

locations.name: Residents' Club East
locations.description: Clubhouse, pool deck and courts shared by the east residences. Illustrative.

locations.name: Trackside Residences South
locations.description: Apartments and townhouses on a street off the ring road, looking north over the circuit. Illustrative.

locations.name: Residences South Street
locations.description: Residential street looping off the ring road, between the apartments and the townhouses.

locations.name: Tennis Courts South
locations.description: Two floodlit tennis courts for residents of the south estate. Illustrative.

locations.name: Swimming Pool South
locations.description: 25 m residents' pool beside the tennis courts. Illustrative.

locations.name: Residents' Club South
locations.description: Clubhouse, pool deck and courts shared by the south residences. Illustrative.

locations.name: Retail Quarter
locations.description: Shops and offices on a shared street just east of the ring road. Illustrative.

locations.name: Retail Street
locations.description: Shopping street off the ring road, between the two rows of the Retail Quarter.

locations.name: Research and Technology Park
locations.description: Research and technology blocks at the south-eastern edge of the site. Illustrative.

locations.name: Research Park Street
locations.description: Access street from the ring road between the two rows of research buildings.

locations.name: N7 National Road
locations.description: The highway along the site's western edge, with direct frontage and two interchanges.

locations.name: N7 North Interchange

locations.name: N7 South Interchange
locations.description: Links the N7 to the ring road, with slip roads in both directions.

locations.name: Waterfront Drive

locations.name: Infield Road
locations.description: The service road into the infield. It crosses over the southern part of the circuit on a bridge, so teams, deliveries and hospitality supplies arrive without crossing the track.

locations.name: Infield Security Checkpoint
locations.description: Security gate on the infield road, before the bridge. Only accredited team, service and hospitality vehicles go through.

locations.name: Car Park P1
locations.description: Between the N7 and the ring road, by the north interchange.

locations.name: Car Park P2
locations.description: Closest parking to the arrival plaza.

locations.name: Car Park P3

locations.name: Aerodrome Apron

locations.name: Aerodrome Terminal

locations.name: Aerodrome Hangars

locations.name: Aerodrome Control Tower

locations.name: Infield hospitality courtyard
locations.description: Premium guest courtyard in the infield, with pavilions, a shaded court and a terrace overlooking the southern corners.

locations.name: Infield hospitality pavilions
locations.description: Three permanent pavilions opening onto the shaded courtyard and southern viewing terrace.

locations.name: Infield viewing terrace
locations.description: Open terrace for hospitality guests, looking south over the return corners.

locations.name: Hospitality courtyard paths
locations.description: Paths linking the courtyard, the pavilion entrances and the viewing terrace to the guest walk.

locations.name: Hospitality shade court
locations.description: Raised shade canopy around the guest courtyard.

locations.name: Infield drainage swale
locations.description: A grassed drainage channel through the infield reserve.

locations.name: Academy handling ground
locations.description: Where academy drivers practise car control and slaloms, beside the karting track and skid pad.

locations.name: Academy handling course
locations.description: A low-speed handling loop and slalom lane, with briefing bays alongside.

locations.name: Academy briefing bays
locations.description: Covered bays where academy drivers prepare and are briefed before going out on the handling course.

locations.description: Where manufacturers and partners show vehicles to visitors and customers, in the eastern automotive campus.

locations.name: Automotive demonstration loop
locations.description: A short, low-speed loop for demonstration drives around the display courts.

locations.name: Vehicle display courts
locations.description: Paved display bays for vehicles on show, inside the demonstration loop.

locations.name: Automotive preparation bays
locations.description: Pavilions where vehicles are prepared before going on display or out on the loop.

locations.name: Demonstration bay markings
locations.description: Marked display bays inside the automotive demonstration loop.

locations.name: Academy campus access
locations.description: External access from the western ring road to karting, its garages, classrooms, skid pad and handling ground.

locations.name: Automotive campus access
locations.description: External access from the eastern ring road to engineering, testing and demonstration facilities.

locations.name: Team logistics yard
locations.description: Where the team transporters park and equipment is prepared, north of the garages. Busiest on a race weekend, and closed to the public.

locations.name: Team logistics service aisle
locations.description: The loading and turning lane through the team logistics yard.

locations.name: Team equipment tents
locations.description: Two grouped equipment shelters facing the logistics aisle, with room for truck holding around them.

locations.name: Circuit response access
locations.description: Emergency and service access behind the eastern spectator banks, reaching the middle and southern parts of the circuit from the ring road.
